title: Sizing items by value, points and risk

C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Sizing
phases.goal: Every item carries value, points, risk and cluster, and those fields decide review depth, effort and bundling.
phases.exit: Z-01 to Z-06 merged; one project's open items all carry the four fields and the first calibration after 20 items is recorded.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: Ledger fields: value, points, risk, cluster
items.what: tools/tracker/ledger.py accepts and validates value (high|medium|low), points (1,2,3,5,8,13), risk (standard|elevated|restricted) and cluster (a surface string) on items. Existing ledgers stay valid without them.
items.done: Validator tests, red first, for each field's bad value; tracker render shows the four fields.

log.evidence: Bundle A (tools/tracker ledger fields, route and lanes): one Sonnet builder after a Haiku scout, one commit per item, branch bundle-a from origin/main af3dbc8, integration branch backlog; sponsor: implement the backlog.

items.title: Routing table from the four fields
items.what: restricted → separate reviewer, sponsor sees the result, never bundled; elevated, or value high with points ≥5 → separate reviewer, own branch; else → gate and tests only, points 1-3 bundled by cluster. Points are set by the lead or scout and left out of the builder's brief (D3). Models unchanged (proposal 23, D8).
items.done: A tracker command prints an item's route; brief template drops points for builders; tests cover each row of the table.

items.what: .common-rules.json declares value defaults per surface; an item's own value overrides the default.
items.done: Declared in common-rules' own .common-rules.json and read by the route command; test for default and override.

items.title: Risk class from paths; common-rules always restricted
items.what: A path list per project sets risk: money, the PhotoVault library, auth and release paths are restricted; every common-rules change is restricted (D4); shared modules elevated; else standard.
items.done: Classifier with tests on real path examples; common-rules items always come back restricted.

items.title: Calibrate points every 20 items
items.what: After every 20 closed items, bin/spend measures tokens per item from transcripts and compares cost per point class; an item over twice its class median is flagged and logged.
items.done: Command with tests on a fixture ledger and transcripts; the first real calibration recorded in a ledger log.

log.event: bin/spend calibrate: every 20 closed items, groups cost by points class, flags >2x class median
log.evidence: tools/calibrate.py, tests/test_calibrate.py (12 tests); PR bundle-l, commit 425a1ae

log.event: reopened and blocked: done requires 'the first real calibration recorded in a ledger log'. The tool works, but bin/spend calibrate skips all 94 closed items -- 0 of 97 items carry points, so there is nothing to calibrate. Unblocking needs the sponsor's call on sizing the backlog (2026-09-16 review, finding F-01 on this ledger)

unblocked by the lead (sponsor: 'fix blocked yourself'). All 97 items sized blind to cost by a Sonnet agent from title/what/done/files only (388 points; 13s: V-01, C-05), applied here. Attribution fixed first (PR #194). First real calibration, 2026-09-16, 88 closed items, worklog collected to a scratch dir: class medians 2pt 1.35M, 3pt 5.39M, 5pt 9.54M, 8pt 7.24M, 13pt 7.83M tokens; 10 flagged: S-03 29.2x (2pt), S-05 4.77x, T-03 4.58x, S-06 3.87x, V-02 3.49x, V-07 2.63x, T-06 2.59x, T-02 2.55x, S-04 2.23x, K-02 2.21x. Caveat, not a pass: only 41 of 88 had worklog data (47 skipped: bundle briefs never tagged an item id; W-01..W-04 skipped as ambiguous across ledgers 19/27), and medians do not rise past 5 points, so the flags are not yet a reliable size signal
log.evidence: bin/spend calibrate --force --project . (calibration-log.jsonl record at 2026-09-16); sizer-output-2026-09-16.json; PR #194

items.done: Tracker board shows the catalogue grouped by cluster; test for grouping and for the same-folder pitfall case.

findings.title: Zero of 97 real items carry value or points, so the whole sizing apparatus is inert on real data: tracker lanes returns an empty table, tracker route says unsized, spend calibrate finds 0 points classes. The maths is correct and tested on fixtures; it has never run on a real item

log.evidence: fixed 2026-09-16: all 97 items sized blind to cost by a Sonnet agent (388 points), applied in PR #195; first real calibration recorded on Z-05

findings.title: Calibration sees 41 of 88 closed items: bundle briefs carry no item id, so their tokens attribute to no item; 8/13-point medians fall below 5-point

log.evidence: deferred 2026-09-16: past bundle tokens cannot be re-attributed; the brief template's first line already tags one item id. Rerun bin/spend calibrate at the next 20 closed items and check coverage rises
